I can quote what the public policy document says; I cannot quote the InterQual criteria language itself because it is not publicly available.

### What I verified
- UnitedHealthcare/Oxford's medical policy that names CPT 63030 ("Laminotomy [hemilaminectomy] with decompression of nerve root(s) … lumbar") is titled **"Spinal Fusion and Decompression."** This exact code, with this exact description, is confirmed as an applicable code in the Commercial/Individual Exchange version, the Community Plan version, and the Oxford Clinical Policy version of this same-titled policy (all share an identical code table structure).
- The current live Oxford-specific PDF URL now 404s on uhcprovider.com (the site appears to have restructured/removed the direct link that search engines still index). I recovered a working copy of the Oxford version via the Internet Archive (Wayback Machine), dated to policy version "Effective 02/01/2025." A UHC "Policy Update Bulletin" indicates this policy was revised again with an April 1, 2026 effective date, so the version actually applied to an August 2026 denial may be a newer revision than the one I could retrieve in full.
- The policy's actual "Coverage Rationale" section does **not** spell out clinical thresholds in the document text. It states that medical necessity is determined by **InterQual® CP: Procedures** modules (e.g., "Decompression +/- Fusion, Lumbar"), which is a licensed, copyrighted McKesson/InterQual product not published in the policy PDF or elsewhere publicly.

## Findings

**Bottom line:** The governing document is a real, identifiable UnitedHealthcare/Oxford policy, but its actual pass/fail medical-necessity criteria are not published in the policy PDF itself — the policy simply points to a licensed, proprietary clinical decision-support tool (InterQual®) that is not publicly viewable. I can quote what the public policy document says; I cannot quote the InterQual criteria language itself because it is not publicly available.

### What I verified
- UnitedHealthcare/Oxford's medical policy that names CPT 63030 ("Laminotomy [hemilaminectomy] with decompression of nerve root(s) … lumbar") is titled **"Spinal Fusion and Decompression."** This exact code, with this exact description, is confirmed as an applicable code in the Commercial/Individual Exchange version, the Community Plan version, and the Oxford Clinical Policy version of this same-titled policy (all share an identical code table structure).
- The current live Oxford-specific PDF URL now 404s on uhcprovider.com (the site appears to have restructured/removed the direct link that search engines still index). I recovered a working copy of the Oxford version via the Internet Archive (Wayback Machine), dated to policy version "Effective 02/01/2025." A UHC "Policy Update Bulletin" indicates this policy was revised again with an April 1, 2026 effective date, so the version actually applied to an August 2026 denial may be a newer revision than the one I could retrieve in full.
- The policy's actual "Coverage Rationale" section does **not** spell out clinical thresholds in the document text. It states that medical necessity is determined by **InterQual® CP: Procedures** modules (e.g., "Decompression +/- Fusion, Lumbar"), which is a licensed, copyrighted McKesson/InterQual product not published in the policy PDF or elsewhere publicly.
